Tooltip_DisplayMode: Style for storage container hover information. Default: X items, Y free slots. Slots only: X/Y slots occupied. Disabled: no hover text.
Tooltip_PreviewUI: Shows a popup UI with the storage container's contents when looking at it.
Tooltip_PreviewUIBackround: Adds dark background behind the Preview UI to improve visibility.
Tooltip_PreviewUIBackgroundOpacity: Adjusts colour of dark preview UI background (0 - translucent, 100% - solid colour).
Tooltip_PreviewUIAnchorX: Moves the preview UI left/right on screen (0 - left edge, 1 - right edge).
Tooltip_PreviewUIAnchorY: Moves the preview UI up/down on screen (0 - bottom, 1 - top).
